title: Subdomain Takeover & Cert Expiry Radar
description: Enter the root domains you own or are authorised to audit. Subdomains are discovered from public Certificate Transparency logs and each live host is checked.

domains.title: Root domains
domains.description: Root domains to audit, e.g. example.com. Only audit domains you own or have permission to test.

maxHostsPerDomain.title: Max hosts per domain
maxHostsPerDomain.description: Upper bound on discovered subdomains audited per root domain. Also caps your spend.

expiryWarningDays.title: Certificate expiry warning (days)
expiryWarningDays.description: Hosts whose certificate expires within this many days are flagged as a risk finding.

onlyRisks.title: Return only risky hosts
onlyRisks.description: If enabled, healthy hosts are skipped and not charged. Ideal for scheduled monitoring.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Number of hosts audited in parallel (1-30).

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy for HTTP and discovery requests. Direct TLS probes always originate from the Actor.
